jobs.title: Director, Product Management — Core Database Engine & AI
jobs.description:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
responsibilities: In this role, you will lead product strategy and execution for Teradata's core database engine: the massively parallel query engine behind every workload on the platform. You will shape the roadmap across the optimizer, execution runtime, workload management, and Global Planner, and own how the engine performs on native storage, cloud object storage, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake.

This role sits at the intersection of the database engine and AI. AI agents are becoming the dominant consumers of enterprise data, issuing high volumes of exploratory, speculative queries, while GenAI and machine learning can improve the engine from the inside. Every core component needs to be rethought in this light, and you will lead that rethink and turn it into a roadmap engineering can build.

Two things anchor the role. Performance: you will spend significant time inside real workloads, query plans, and benchmarks, working with engineering to deliver measurable gains release after release. SQL: you will be the steward of Teradata SQL, the surface customers live in, making its syntax, semantics, and ergonomics simpler, more expressive, and safer for developers, analysts, and AI agents.
Strategy: Own the engine vision and multi-year roadmap, co-owning architecture direction with senior engineering leaders and making principled trade-offs across performance, cost, and complexity.
AI and agents: Lead the rethink of every core engine component for AI agents as the new dominant workload, and apply GenAI and ML inside the engine to make it faster and more autonomous.

Optimizer, execution, and workload management: Agents send many redundant queries. Explore optimizing across queries, sharing intermediate results, and returning early or approximate answers. Apply learned cardinality and cost models and LLM-assisted rewrite, with guardrails that protect plan stability. Define how workload management absorbs bursty machine traffic through agent identity, priorities, and budgets.

Performance: Work hands-on with engineering on query plans, regressions, and bottlenecks. Own the benchmark suite and KPIs (latency, concurrency, plan stability, price-performance), including agentic workloads, and build regression gates into releases.

Open Table formats: Own the engine side of Iceberg and Delta Lake (scan planning, pruning, pushdown, write paths) so customers never trade performance for openness. Automate statistics, clustering, and compaction with AI.

SQL language and query interface: Design features that turn complex problems into simple, readable queries, reduce footguns while keeping power and backward compatibility, and stay aligned with ANSI SQL. Make the dialect something agents can safely generate and execute, and let agents steer with cost estimates, plan explanations, and hints.
Who You'll Work With

You will work with senior database engineering leaders, performance engineering, AI platform teams, the open table format product team, sales engineering, and executive leadership across the US, Europe, and India. This role starts as an individual contributor, leading through technical depth and influence and mentoring Staff-level PMs. It may grow into managing a team of product managers.
What Makes You a Qualified Candidate
requirements: First-principles thinking and good taste: willingness to question long-standing database assumptions, a preference for elegance over verbosity, customer obsession, daily use of GenAI tools, and the credibility to earn the trust of senior engineers
The ability to read research critically, separate promise from hype, and design experiments to prove value, with a track record of setting multi-year platform strategy
A plus: experience designing SQL features or language extensions, hands-on work with optimizers or learned database components, open-source contributions, or publications at SIGMOD, VLDB, or CIDR
Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. responsibilities: In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.

On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.

On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a

Principal Product Manager

to lead our Factory Tech within our Sourcing team. Quince is building the operating system for the factories, mills, and vendors that make our products. Factory OS is the software our supply partners run their operations on - planning, scheduling, capacity, quality, and compliance - replacing spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one system of record for how goods actually get made.

As Principal PM, you own this platform end to end: the vision, the roadmap, and the hard calls about what we build, for whom, and in what order. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with vendors and mills on the factory floor, and with our engineering, ops, and sourcing teams, to turn messy real-world production workflows into reliable software. This is a builders role with outsized scope - you're defining a category, not iterating on a mature one.
responsibilities: Own the Factory OS product strategy - from vendor/mill discovery through roadmap, specs, and launch - and be accountable for adoption and measurable operational impact (adoption, on-time production, capacity utilization, quality yield, planning accuracy).
Design the core operational workflows - production planning, scheduling, capacity management, order and material tracking - so they hold up under the reality of a working factory, not just a demo.

Build for compliance and auditability from day one. Factory data touches sourcing, labor, quality, and trade requirements. You'll make compliance, traceability, and auditability first-class product surfaces, not bolt-ons - and ensure the system produces the records our partners and Quince are held to.
Drive real adoption on the floor. A system that vendors and mills won't use is worthless. You'll obsess over onboarding, change management, and the gap between 'shipped' and 'used daily'

Set the AI and automation thesis. Architect Factory OS for a future where every automatable workflow is executed by an agent, not a person clicking through screens. Decide which steps to automate first, design the human-in-the-loop and exception paths, and treat agents, APIs, and humans as composable actors in auditable, business-grade workflows.
Partner deeply cross-functionally with engineering, ML, design, sourcing, and factory operations - translating ambiguous problem statements into shipped products.
requirements: Required
10+ years in product management, including senior/principal-level ownership of a complex B2B SaaS or operational software product from zero-to-one or through significant scale

Direct experience building workflow-automation software - you've taken manual, multi-step operational processes and turned them into software that runs them, and you understand the difference between digitizing a workflow and actually automating it.

Domain proximity to manufacturing, supply chain, or factory/operations software (MES/MOM, ERP, planning/scheduling, quality, or sourcing systems). You don't need to have run a factory, but you need to have built for people who do.

A credible point of view on AI and agents in production software - not slideware. You've shipped, or can clearly articulate how you'd ship, agentic and human-in-the-loop automation into a real operational system.
A track record with compliance-sensitive products - you've built software where auditability, traceability, and regulatory or contractual requirements were core to the design.
Hands-on AI fluency - you use AI tools daily for discovery, spec-writing, and prototyping, and you build to think.
Comfort in the field - you'll spend time with vendors and mills, and you're energized (not deterred) by messy, physical, real-world operations
preferred: Experience building software used by external partners/suppliers (not just internal or single-tenant customers).
Background in apparel, textiles, consumer goods, or hard-goods manufacturing supply chains

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager - myRico
jobs.description:
Product Manager - myRico

HSR, Bangalore, India

Mission

The best teams spend too much time keeping work moving. Context is scattered across conversations, documents and tools. Decisions get lost. Dependencies go unnoticed. Someone has to remember what matters, connect the dots and follow through.

We’re building myRico to help carry that work.

Our ambition is an AI teammate that understands your company—its goals, people, decisions and ways of working—and uses that understanding to help the team get things done. A teammate that earns trust through useful work, sound judgment and dependable follow-through.

Our starting point is helping software teams move projects from intent to delivery. Success means less effort spent coordinating and correcting work, and a shorter path to an outcome the team can stand behind.
responsibilities: We’re hiring our founding Product Manager to help turn that ambition into a product that teams rely on every day.

You’ll work closely with the founders, engineers and early customers to figure out where Rico creates the most value, what we should build next and whether it actually works. You’ll own the loop from understanding a problem to shipping a solution, watching people use it and making it better.

Some of the hardest questions are also the most interesting. When should Rico act on its own? When should it ask? What should it remember? How does it earn permission to take on more responsibility? How do we know it has saved someone time once we account for the effort of directing, reviewing and correcting it?

In practice, you might spend a morning watching a customer run a project, prototype a better workflow that afternoon, and work with engineering to put it in their hands that week. You’ll read conversations, investigate failures, challenge assumptions and make the small product decisions that determine whether an AI teammate feels useful or exhausting.
You’ll help shape both the product and how we build it. That means choosing a few problems worth solving deeply, making clear tradeoffs and staying accountable for what happens after launch.
This role is based in Bangalore and would require 5 days in office.
requirements: Customer obsession. You get close enough to users to understand how their work actually happens, including the workarounds they’ve stopped noticing.
Product judgment. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear decision about what to build, what to leave out and what evidence would change your mind.
A builder’s instinct. You use prototypes, experiments and AI tools to make ideas tangible and learn quickly.
Technical fluency. You can reason with engineers about AI behavior, memory, integrations, permissions and the tradeoffs between quality, latency and cost.
Care for the details. You notice when an interaction creates confusion, a notification interrupts at the wrong time or a confident answer hasn’t earned that confidence.
Ownership. You follow a problem through discovery, delivery and adoption. You stay with it when the first solution falls short.
Clear communication. You write precisely, explain your reasoning and disagree thoughtfully.
Experience

You’ve helped take a product or meaningful feature from an unclear problem to real usage. You can explain the decisions you made, the tradeoffs you accepted and what you learned when users surprised you.
Your background might be product management, engineering, design or founding a company. We care about evidence of good judgment and useful things you’ve shipped.

You need a fully defined roadmap before you can make progress.
preferred: You’ve built an AI product and dealt with its behavior in real use.

You can build working prototypes yourself.

Digital Product Manager (AI) The Digital Product Manager at Amgen oversees the lifecycle of digital products, working closely with various teams to define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.
responsibilities: We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.

Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.

This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.

Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.

Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.

Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.

Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.
Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level.

Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement.

Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive-ready narratives. Help leaders make informed decisions about where to invest, scale, or stop.

Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Experienced Product Owner is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. This role focuses on the Total Rewards: Compensation & Advance Compensation Module. Additional module expertise is a plus.

Key
responsibilities: Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery
Own your assigned Workday module(s): Compensation & Advance Compensation end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.

Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.
PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management

Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.
requirements: 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.

Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

jobs.title: AVP, Product Management, User Experience
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Odessa is seeking a senior product leader to own the end-to-end user experience strategy across the platform. This role will turn product experience into a company-level advantage by combining product management, experience design, customer discovery, analytics, performance, and platform thinking. The leader will move the organization beyond isolated visual improvements toward simpler business workflows, stronger design ownership, and measurable improvements in adoption, usability, and customer confidence.

Primary role

The AVP, Product Management, User Experience will define and communicate a multi-year product experience vision, principles, and roadmap. The role will establish clear ownership for product experience, prioritize high-usage and high-friction journeys, and align Product, Digital Experience, Framework, Engineering, Automation and AI around shared priorities. This leader will translate customer and market insights into executable product decisions and ensure user-facing capabilities are designed for simplicity, responsiveness, quality, and scale.
responsibilities: Set the UX product strategy: Own a multi-year product experience vision and roadmap that connects market needs, measurable customer outcomes, platform constraints and Odessa’s broader product strategy.
Own high-impact journeys: Prioritize the most-used and highest-friction workflows using customer feedback, telemetry, product analytics, usability evidence, and commercial impact.
Simplify the experience: Reduce unnecessary screens, clicks and context switches; promote task-oriented journeys, progressive disclosure and role-relevant experiences that hide avoidable complexity.
Integrate UI, UX, performance and business experience: Treat visual design, workflow design, terminology, responsiveness, and process fit as one product experience, with common outcomes and measures.

Lead discovery and product definition: Engage customers, prospects, domain experts, and internal stakeholders to frame problems, define target outcomes, shape requirements and make clear portfolio and sequencing trade-offs.

Drive roadmap execution: Convert strategy into sequenced initiatives, business cases, product requirements and release plans; partner with Framework, Engineering and Architecture to balance near-term improvements with foundational platform evolution.

Strengthen design ownership: Build a high-performing product and design capability that creates high-fidelity concepts while owning product and domain understanding, product decisions, stakeholder influence and longer-term UX direction.
Institutionalize customer-centered practices: Establish journey mapping, prototyping, usability validation, benchmarking, and experience-quality reviews across the product lifecycle.

Make prioritization evidence-based: Define telemetry and product analytics for priority workflows, establish adoption and friction measures, and use evidence to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
Champion quality by design: Introduce early UX and design-system quality reviews, so experience defects are identified before customer releases, and user-facing quality improves.

Influence across the organization: Create shared goals across Product, Digital Experience, Framework, Engineering, QA, Delivery, Sales, and Customer Success; resolve cross-functional trade-offs and communicate decisions clearly.
Represent the product experience: Bring a strong product narrative to executive reviews, strategic customer discussions, product demonstrations, and go-to-market planning.
requirements: 15+ years of product management or related enterprise software experience, including significant senior leadership responsibility.
Proven ownership of product strategy, portfolio priorities, and multi-release roadmaps for complex enterprise products or platforms.
Strong understanding of user experience strategy, interaction and journey design, design systems, usability research, and product analytics.
Ability to connect customer problems, business outcomes, market context, and technical constraints to make clear product decisions.
Experience leading cross-functional work across Product, Design, Engineering, Architecture, QA, Delivery, Sales, and Customer Success.
Demonstrated success building and leading senior product and design talent and strengthening product and domain capability.
Executive-level communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with people who bring different viewpoints.
Data-driven approach to adoption, usability, performance, quality, and roadmap impact.
preferred: Experience with complex, configurable enterprise applications where scale, performance and domain complexity shape the user experience.
Experience in financial services, asset finance, leasing, or lending.

As a Product Manager, to be located at Navi Mumbai, India, you will be responsible for driving product portfolio competitiveness, profitability, supply flexibility, and growth enablement across the India Consumer Solutions business. The role serves as a key business leader responsible for evaluating and executing strategies that optimize manufacturing footprint, external contract manufacturing (ECM), sourcing options, product supply networks, and overall value chain performance.

The incumbent is responsible for assessing and recommending make-versus-buy, buy-sell, external manufacturing, and strategic partnership opportunities that improve profitability, increase supply resilience, support growth, and strengthen long-term competitiveness within India.

The Product Manager translates business strategy into actionable initiatives, governs value chain improvement programs, and drives disciplined execution through cross-functional teams. The role requires balancing short-term operational requirements with longer-term portfolio, manufacturing, and investment decisions while ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer commitments.

Working closely with regional Product Management, Commercial, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Technology, and external manufacturing partners, the Product Manager provides

Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships and external manufacturing opportunities that support market growth, improve flexibility, and strengthen supply network competitiveness. (Derived from the strategic partnership mandate you described.)

Develop business cases and recommendations for manufacturing footprint optimization, strategic partnerships, and supply network improvements that support future business growth.
Influence regional product, supply, manufacturing, innovation, and investment strategies to ensure alignment with India business priorities and market opportunities.
Communicate strategic recommendations, business risks, opportunity assessments, and execution updates effectively to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

responsibilities: Senior Product Manager, Fleet Management Systems (FMS)
Location
BLR/GGN

Delhivery's freight network operates across thousands of vehicles, vendors, customers, and trips every day. Orion and our Fleet Management Systems sit at the center of this ecosystem—connecting demand creation, supply allocation, procurement, trip execution, tracking, documentation, and financial closure.

As Senior Product Manager for FMS, you will own products that make freight operations faster, more automated, and more efficient. You will work at the intersection of customers, operations, supply, engineering, data, and AI—simplifying complex workflows and progressively moving them from manual coordination to intelligent, system-driven execution.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complicated operational problems and turning them into scalable products.
What You Will Do

Own the roadmap, not just the backlog — Define product strategy and roadmap across freight and fleet workflows from demand/indent creation and supply-demand matching to trip execution, tracking, documentation, and closure. Define clear business and product KPIs and own outcomes.

Automate operations using AI — Identify workflows currently dependent on calls, emails, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, or manual decision-making and redesign them using AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent recommendations.

Go deep into freight operations — Understand how customers raise demand, how supply teams source vehicles, how vendors bid and allocate capacity, and how trips are executed on ground. Spend time with operations, vendors, drivers, and customers to understand where systems diverge from reality.

Drive measurable operational outcomes — Use data to identify bottlenecks and measure improvements in metrics such as turnaround time, automation/adoption, vehicle placement, tracking compliance, vendor performance, and operational productivity.

Build for scale and reliability — Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design systems that can handle complex workflows, integrations, real-time events, and large transaction volumes without creating operational fragility.
requirements: 4+ years of product management experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, fleet management, marketplaces, B2B platforms, or a fast-paced internet company.
Strong product fundamentals with demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, quantify their impact, and translate them into scalable products.
Strong operational instinct—you are comfortable understanding workflows on the ground rather than designing products only from meeting rooms.
Hands-on SQL and data skills—you should be comfortable pulling and analysing your own data, building funnels, identifying failure patterns, and using data to challenge assumptions.
Practical fluency with modern AI tooling—LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, RAG, and AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar environments.

Strong systems thinking. You can reason across workflows involving customers, vendors, vehicles, drivers, payments, documents, APIs, and multiple internal systems rather than optimizing one screen in isolation.
Ability to influence across teams without relying on authority and to drive adoption after the product has shipped.
Why This Role

Freight operations have traditionally depended heavily on people coordinating through calls, messages, spreadsheets, and fragmented systems. At Delhivery's scale, the opportunity is to fundamentally change that.
FMS is evolving from a system that records freight operations into a platform that can increasingly understand demand, recommend decisions, automate coordination, and manage execution.
This role gives you the opportunity to build that transformation at scale—combining logistics, marketplaces, data, and AI to redefine how freight moves.

responsibilities: Credit Data Platform to own CredHive's proprietary B2B trade data network and the intelligence layer built on top of it. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Clinical Data
jobs.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Position Summary: We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Patient Record & Insights Zone (PRIZ) and the Chart Data & ChartSync team in Bangalore. The Patient Record & Insights Zone is focused on making every practice ready for every patient by helping practices understand a patient’s evolving clinical story through connected longitudinal data across care settings, improving readiness, strengthening care transitions, and supporting better decisions before, during, and between visits.

As a Senior Product Manager on the Chart Data & ChartSync team, you will play a key role in advancing this mission. ChartSync helps bring important patient information from organizations, documents, and external data sources into athenaOne and make it usable within the patient record.

You will own defined problem spaces within the Chart Data & ChartSync roadmap, working closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Management, and other cross-functional teams to turn product direction into measurable outcomes.

The opportunity is to make the patient-record experience increasingly seamless, intelligent, and automated by getting the right information into the record at the right time, reducing unnecessary manual review and reconciliation, and helping clinicians quickly understand what has changed and what requires their attention.

This role
responsibilities: Own defined problem spaces and initiatives within the Chart Data & ChartSync roadmap, from discovery through delivery, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
Partner with Product Management leadership and other Product Managers to shape product strategy, priorities, and multi-release roadmaps for the broader product area.
Develop deep expertise in users, customers, clinical workflows, and the underlying data ecosystem.
Understand how clinicians find, review, reconcile, and use clinical information from outside their practice and identify opportunities to reduce friction and improve confidence in the patient record.

Manage multiple product threads simultaneously, balancing discovery, delivery, customer needs, technical dependencies, and longer-term roadmap work while maintaining focus on the highest-value problems.
Serve as Product Owner for Agile/Scrum teams supporting assigned areas of Chart Data and ChartSync.
Define priorities, refine epics and user stories, and make thoughtful trade-offs between scope, quality, and timing.
Drive the end-to-end product development lifecycle, including problem discovery, requirements definition, user experience, delivery, rollout, measurement, adoption, and iteration.
Establish product metrics and success criteria for assigned initiatives and use quantitative and qualitative evidence to guide product decisions.

Partner closely with Engineering, UX/Design, Analytics, and other Product teams to simplify the flow of incoming clinical data, improve data quality and relevance, and bring information into workflows where it is most useful.
Identify and manage cross-product dependencies across athenaOne to create a coherent experience rather than solving individual data and workflow problems in isolation.
Engage with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product Marketing, and customers to understand needs, communicate product direction, and support successful adoption.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Security Testing
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager – Managed Security Testing

Location: (Vadodara / Pune / Hyderabad Office)

Shift time: UK Shift housr

Report to: SVP

Job Description:

As a Senior Product Manager of Managed Security Testing at VikingCloud, you will be responsible for the strategic planning, development, and execution of our offensive security testing services, including penetration testing as a service (PTaaS), vulnerability assessments, phishing simulations, social engineering testing, and specialized security assessments. You will own the product roadmap for VikingCloud's managed security testing portfolio, working closely with our internal security testing teams, third-party testing partners, and customers to deliver high-quality offensive security services that help merchants and financial institutions identify and remediate security weaknesses before attackers can exploit them. This role requires deep understanding of offensive security methodologies, industry certifications and frameworks (CREST, PTES, OWASP, PCI DSS ASV), and the ability to bridge technical security testing with compliance requirements. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including security consultants, engineering, sales, and customer success to build scalable, automated testing platforms while maintaining the rigor and quality expected from professional security assessments. Your work will directly support customers' compliance programs (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001) while providing actionable
responsibilities: Product Strategy & Vision: Develop and execute a comprehensive product strategy for VikingCloud's managed security testing services, including penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, web application testing, mobile app testing, API testing, phishing simulations, social engineering assessments, and automated testing. Define the product vision that balances automation and scalability with the technical rigor required for professional security testing.

AI Security Testing (AISec): Develop testing methodologies and a comprehensive product strategy for Larege Language Models (LLMs) AI Agents, Chatbots, and other AI powered technologies. This includes an “AI Red Teaming” strategy and packages for testing the robustness of customer-facing AI applications.

PTaaS Platform Development: Lead the development of VikingCloud's Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS) platform, creating modern delivery mechanisms that provide continuous testing, real-time reporting, seamless remediation tracking, and collaborative workflows between testers and customers. Define platform requirements for test scoping, scheduling, execution tracking, finding management, retesting, and certification delivery.

Testing Methodology & Standards: Ensure all security testing services adhere to industry-recognized methodologies and frameworks including CREST standards, Penetration Testing Execution Standard (PTES), OWASP Testing Guide, NIST SP 800-115, and PCI DSS testing requirements. Maintain current knowledge of CREST accreditation requirements and ensure VikingCloud's services meet or exceed these standards. Define quality assurance processes for testing deliverables.

Certification & Compliance Alignment: Build security testing services that directly support customer compliance requirements including PCI DSS (ASV scanning, segmentation testing, penetration testing), SOC 2 Type II (security testing evidence), ISO 27001, NIST frameworks, and industry-specific regulations. Position testing services as essential compliance components that provide both security value and audit evidence.

Roadmap Planning & Prioritization: Create and maintain detailed product roadmaps for testing services and PTaaS platform capabilities. Prioritize features and service enhancements based on customer feedback, compliance requirements, competitive analysis, revenue potential, and operational efficiency gains. Balance automation initiatives with maintaining high-quality manual testing where required.

Phishing & Social Engineering Programs: Develop comprehensive phishing simulation and security awareness testing capabilities including campaign management, template libraries, user tracking, training integration, and reporting dashboards. Create social engineering testing services including vishing, smishing, physical security testing, and pretexting scenarios tailored to different industries and threat models.

Service Delivery & Scalability: Design service delivery models that enable VikingCloud to scale testing services efficiently while maintaining quality. Define when to use internal testers versus third-party partners, automation versus manual testing, and on-demand versus scheduled assessments. Create standardized testing packages for common use cases while allowing customization for complex environments.

Vulnerability Management Integration: Integrate security testing services with VikingCloud's existing vulnerability scanning and management capabilities. Create workflows that enable customers to move seamlessly from continuous scanning to targeted penetration testing to remediation verification. Build unified vulnerability management dashboards that combine scan results, pen test findings, and remediation status.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information security, or related technical field required; advanced degree (M.S. in Cybersecurity) or MBA is a plus.
10-14 years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, or security consulting with at least 4-5 years in product management or service delivery leadership roles.

Hands-on penetration testing experience including web applications, APIs, mobile applications, network infrastructure, wireless networks, and cloud environments. Direct experience conducting security assessments, not just managing testing programs.

Deep understanding of offensive security methodologies and frameworks including CREST standards, Penetration Testing Execution Standard (PTES), OWASP Testing Guide, OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, SANS Top 25, and MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS frameworks.

Strong knowledge of CREST certification pathways and accreditation requirements including CREST Registered Tester (CRT), CREST Certified Tester (CCT), CREST Practitioner Security Analyst (CPSA), and CREST infrastructure, application, and specialist certifications. Understanding of how CREST accreditation differentiates testing services in the market.

Professional security certifications strongly preferred including OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional), GPEN (GIAC Penetration Tester), GWAPT (GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester), CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker), or CREST certifications. Multiple certifications demonstrating breadth of expertise are highly valuable.

Experience with compliance-driven security testing including PCI DSS penetration testing requirements (Requirement 11.4), PCI DSS Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV) program, SOC 2 security testing, ISO 27001 testing requirements, and other regulatory frameworks.

Familiarity with penetration testing tools and platforms including Burp Suite, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, Nmap, Nessus, OWASP ZAP, Kali Linux, and emerging automated testing tools. Understanding of when automation adds value versus when manual testing is required.
Experience with AI-augmented security testing, managing the security of AI/ML pipelines, prompt engineering for security testing, and use of AI agents in automated vulnerability discovery.
Knowledge of the EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and other emerging AI regulations

Experience with PTaaS platforms or building security testing delivery platforms. Understanding of modern testing workflows including continuous testing, API-driven integrations, real-time reporting, and collaborative remediation tracking.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter
responsibilities: Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
Where you'll leave your mark?

Own Sprinto's AI browser extensions and AI features end to end — one of several streams within our AI pod, alongside accuracy baselining and automations — as its business owner, not just its product manager.
Define the problem statement from first principles — figure out what's worth building, why, and for whom, before a line of code is written.
Build the product and take it to first customers — work hands-on with an initial set of customers, one on one, to get it to a successful POC stage.
Drive distribution and adoption — partner with CX, Sales, and Marketing to take what worked in POCs to wider launch and measurable adoption across the customer base.
Own accuracy and quality for AI-driven features — set the bar, know the pitfalls of building on non-deterministic systems, and keep improving output reliability post-launch.
Operate with senior-level autonomy — set direction for this stream, make calls without waiting for a mandate, and be accountable for outcomes, not deliverables.

Cloud Common Services (CCS) builds the essential cloud infrastructure and platform services that power the Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP). jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager - Data Protection
jobs.description:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
responsibilities: In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience.

Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance.

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.
What Makes You a Qualified Candidate
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
12+ years of product management experience, including 6+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers

Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence.
Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences.

You will operate at the intersection of product leadership, systems architecture, platform strategy, developer experience, and ecosystem development. You will partner with engineering leaders, architects, security experts, and product teams across Microsoft to shape how first-party, partner, and customer-built connectors are developed, onboarded, managed, discovered, and used across Copilot experiences.

responsibilities: Define and drive the long-term vision, strategy, roadmap, and platform investments for the Copilot Connectors.

Shape the end-to-end connector lifecycle, including development, validation, certification, publishing, deployment, discovery, configuration, monitoring, updating, and retirement.
Define how connector capabilities are represented and packaged so customers can access knowledge, tools, and actions through a coherent experience rather than managing fragmented integrations.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Product Lead Data Management Services

HSBC Data & Analytics Office (DAO) promotes a data-driven culture across HSBC through our strategy of:

Protect: To protect our data we need robust policies for data management and enhanced governance e.g. data that is consumed from a trusted source, meets quality standards, and complies with regulatory obligations.

Connect: Move to a data-led culture through enhanced training including on the job opportunities. Our talent is the glue between protecting our data and unlocking value for our customers.

Unlock. Value is unlocked when we deliver on the opportunities our well-managed data presents e.g. improving customer / colleague experience, increasing revenue, commercialising our data, optimising capital, enhancing risk management or reducing costs.

We are hiring a Product Lead
responsibilities: DMS within Data Management Services (part of Data & Analytics Office)

The Data function owns the bank’s data controls and the ecosystem of tools that allows every business and function to implement and evidence those controls. That ecosystem is being rebuilt: legacy tools are being redesigned, new platforms are being brought in, and the target state is a fully automated, control-by-design data estate, where data quality, lineage, metadata, classification, retention, access and issue management are largely machine-executed rather than manually attested.

We are hiring a Product Lead to own that estate end to end. This is a build-and-scale mandate on a compressed timeline, not a steady-state product management role. The successful candidate will set the product strategy, consolidate a fragmented tooling landscape into a coherent platform, lead the product community, and be personally accountable for landing the target state within an aggressive delivery window.
Governance and Committee Memberships

The jobholder will continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.

The jobholder will also adhere to and be able to demonstrate adherence to internal controls. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.

The jobholder will implement the Group compliance policy by containing compliance risk in liaison with Global Head of Compliance, Global Compliance Officer, Area Compliance Officer or Local Compliance Officer. The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply

Own the DMS product vision and multi-year roadmap to deliver the bank-wide automated data control journey (control-by-design, scalable and measurable). Convert control outcomes into deliverable increments (epics/features) with clear acceptance criteria and benefits tracking (e.g., automation rate, evidence quality, adoption, cycle-time reduction).

Partner with Data Technology and Architecture to define the target state and make explicit buy / build / configure / retire decisions, including legacy rationalisation and decommissioning. Create platform consistency by setting common product standards/patterns across DMS (e.g., workflow, APIs, integration patterns, MI/metrics, auditability) so tools operate as one coherent estate.

Lead and develop the Product Owner community across the DMS portfolio, setting direction, ways of working and a consistent bar for discovery, prioritisation and outcome delivery. Orchestrate delivery through matrix technology teams (without direct line management), aligning priorities, managing dependencies, removing blockers and ensuring shared accountability for outcomes.

Run portfolio-level prioritisation and capacity allocation to ensure engineering effort is focused on the highest-risk/highest-value control outcomes, with realistic sequencing and transparent trade-offs. Establish and operate strong delivery governance to maintain delivery momentum and quality.

Drive adoption and change at scale (training, communications, migrations) ensuring DMS tooling becomes the “path of least resistance” for Data Owners, Data Stewards and control teams. Ensure risk, regulatory and control-by-design compliance: DMS products must meet HSBC standards for security, resilience, data privacy/records management and third-party risk, and provide defensible evidence/MI for Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit.

1–2 years of experience at a SaaS or software company — in product, growth, marketing analytics, customer success or operations — and a clear interest in moving into product

jobs.description:
We're

Karat

, the world's largest interviewing company.

Karat is transforming organizations around the world. We provide a powerful system for technical leaders at companies like PayPal, Atlassian, and Citi who want to take control of how they hire top engineers, elevate their teams and contractors, and stay ahead. At the core of Karat’s system are live, expert-led interviews, analytics designed to give leaders maximum visibility, and the most robust interview performance dataset in the world.

Come join our

Product

team

Our Product team is committed to driving forward Karat’s mission to make interviews predictive, fair, and enjoyable. We are focused on providing deeper value to engineering and talent leaders, hiring managers, recruiters, candidates, and Interview Engineers.

What you will do

As Principal Product Manager, you will own the product vision, strategy, and execution for how hiring managers and their teams experience our platform — from onboarding through interview results and client-run assessments. You'll leverage deep user empathy and product thinking to build experiences that make it effortless for enterprise hiring teams to evaluate and act on candidate signal, collaborating across engineering, content, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

This position requires a schedule that overlaps with U.S. business hours.

Analytics & Insights:
Analyze usage and outcome data to improve the hiring-manager experience; design experiments to test new onboarding, preference, and results-delivery approaches.
Market & Customer Focus:
Track performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities; partner with Go-to-Market teams on expansion strategies; build compelling business cases for new offerings.
The experience you will bring
8+ years of product management experience across B2B and B2C offerings, ideally with prior experience as a software developer
Genuine passion for and track record of building B2B SaaS applications; comfortable running customer discovery calls and QBRs and translating enterprise feedback directly into product decisions
Demonstrated experience defining, launching, selling, and scaling successful products with measurable business impact

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Flights OTA
jobs.description:
Own a Flights problem space end-to-end - not a screen, not a funnel stage. Youll take the traveller journey across shopping, booking, and post-booking and be accountable for how it performs commercially and how it behaves when reality intervenes: fares that move, tickets that fail, schedules that change, and travellers who need to cancel.

The scope deliberately spans surfaces. Metasearch and comparison remain central to how travellers find us, but the interesting problems now sit in the seams - where a supplier switch at booking time creates a support contact three days later, where a baggage allowance we didnt parse at search time becomes a refund dispute, where the fare rule we couldnt read at purchase becomes a $700 agency debit memo six months on.

This is an individual contributor role with real leverage. Youll lead cross-functional squads across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Supply, Commercial, Finance Ops, and Customer Support, and youll be measured on outcomes - conversion, traffic quality, provider performance, cost-to-serve, retention - not on shipping velocity.

What youll actually work on

These are live, funded programmes, not aspirations. The detail will shift the shape wont. Here are some examples of problems you ll need to solve.

Zero Touch - self-service refunds and exchanges. Most of our contact-centre volume is travellers asking whether they can cancel or change, and most of them dont proceed once they see the cost. Youll make that answer instant,
responsibilities: 90% accurate is not a pass. In most products a heuristic thats right nine times out of ten is a win. Here, the 10% is a traveller told their ticket was refundable when it wasnt - so we either break a promise or eat the loss - or a void we shouldnt have processed, which returns as an airline debit six months later with a penalty attached. Youll have to reason about failure cost per decision, not aggregate accuracy.
The truth is spread across systems that dont agree. There is no single row you can trust. Much of this work is deciding what the source of truth is before you can automate anything on top of it.

Money moves before the answer is known. Funds have often already gone to the supplier by the time we decide what the traveller is owed. Product decisions here land directly on finance reconciliation, and youll need to design with that in mind rather than hand it over.

Complexity were choosing to keep. Continuous reprice optimization is a significant profit stream. We are not turning it off to make servicing simpler. Youll be automating on top of a system that deliberately mutates bookings after sale.
Some rules only exist in someones head. A real part of this role is operational design: turning tacit knowledge held by a handful of people into something a system - or an AI agent - can act on.

Strategy and vision. Define and evolve the strategy for your Flights problem space, aligned to marketplace growth and commercial objectives. Identify where we can be structurally more competitive, and translate that into measurable outcomes.

Roadmap and delivery. Own the roadmap and its sequencing, prioritising on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and dependency risk. Lead initiatives through discovery, validation, delivery, experimentation, launch, and optimisation. Balance near-term commercial wins against foundational platform investment - and be able to defend the trade-off.

Experience quality. Champion a fast, intuitive, and above all truthful experience at every stage. Optimise relevance, price presentation, filtering, comparison, provider selection, fulfilment, and self-service. Validate with research, experimentation, and behavioural data.

Data and performance. Partner with Data Science and Analytics on funnel health. Define and track KPIs across acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, traffic quality, provider performance, cost-to-serve, and marketplace efficiency.

Cross-functional leadership. Work across Engineering, Design, Supply, Commercial, Marketing, Revenue Management, Finance Ops, and Customer Support. Communicate priorities, decisions, and trade-offs clearly. Build alignment without direct authority.

Market intelligence. Track airline distribution shifts, NDC adoption, competitor moves, and emerging technology - particularly AI applied to fare interpretation and servicing - and turn that into initiatives.

Risk and operational excellence. Surface delivery, technical, commercial, and regulatory risk early. Improve experimentation frameworks and development process. Keep decisions consistent with platform stability and long-term maintainability.
requirements: Required - non-negotiable
5+ years in Product Management, with direct ownership of customer-facing digital products.
Meaningful experience as a PM in a Flights OTA - a business that sells and services flight tickets. Metasearch, aggregation, comparison, or affiliate-only experience does not substitute for this.

Depth across more than one flights problem space. For example shopping and booking booking and post-booking supply and shopping. We want someone who has seen how decisions in one stage surface as cost or breakage in another.

Working fluency in flight distribution mechanics. You should be comfortable, unprompted, with: PNRs versus tickets and why they diverge fare rules, fare families and FBC logic refunds versus exchanges, voluntary versus involuntary EDIFACT and NDC behaviour across GDSs LCC direct-connect realities ancillaries and baggage agency debit memos and settlement.

Comfort with ambiguity in the data itself. Youve shipped in e

Location: Plano, TX, Lawrence, PA, or India (preferred for direct access to our hardware labs), or Remote (US).

Travel: 20%

What You Will Do
responsibilities: Technical Portfolio Strategy and Optimization: Evaluate the existing networking, converter, and console server portfolio to drive SKU rationalization, BOM optimization, and margin improvement. Identify which products to consolidate or sunset and which high-margin lines to scale.

OEM/ODM Vendor Architecture and Management: Act as the primary technical interface with our global manufacturing partners. Influence their roadmaps, negotiate technical SLAs, and drive root-cause analysis and supplier quality corrections for field failures.

Rigorous Product Engineering and QA Leadership: Own the firmware and hardware validation gate. Design and execute New Product Introduction testing, regulatory compliance verification, and automated test frameworks.

Level 3 Escalation Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex field failures. Perform hands-on debugging in the lab, translate field data into engineering requirements, and enforce corrective actions with vendors.

Engineering Impact of Compliance and Certification: Partner with the Compliance Manager, who tracks market mandates and certification requirements. You translate those mandates into hardware and firmware requirements, evaluating vendor BOMs and architectures so that component or firmware changes do not silently invalidate FIPS, TAA, UL, NERC CIP, and other relevant standards.

Lifecycle and Knowledge Execution: Manage the product lifecycle from NPI through End-of-Life. Build the technical documentation, training material, troubleshooting guides, firmware test checklists, and compatibility matrices that empower support, Product Ops, and adjacent product managers.
Cross-Portfolio Technical Collaboration: Act as the networking subject matter expert for the broader product organization, supporting Sales and Product Marketing with technical content.
Core Technical Expertise

Layer 2 and Layer 3 Networking Standards: VLANs (802.1Q), Spanning Tree Protocols (STP/RSTP/MSTP), link aggregation (LACP), QoS/CoS prioritization, IP routing (Static, OSPF), IGMP snooping, and security mechanisms like 802.1X and ACLs.

Media Conversion and Physical Layer Mechanics: Optical and copper interfaces (SFP/SFP+, RJ-45, single-mode vs. multi-mode fiber, wavelength specifications), Power over Ethernet standards, and rate-matching mechanics.
PoE System Engineering: PSE/PD classification and power budget validation across 802.3af, 802.3at, intelligent detection and backward-compatibility behavior, and downstream device power profiling.

Harsh-Environment and Industrial Specifications: Industrial hardening, wide operating temperatures, high EMC/EMI immunity, redundant power inputs, ring redundancy protocols, and DIN-rail or panel-mount deployment.

DESCRIPTION

The Outbound and Flow team within Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) is looking for an experienced Product Manager (Technical) to own the vision and strategy for Routing and Mansort products, based out of Bangalore. Our team provides the products and services responsible for outbound fulfillment — ingesting shipments from upstream systems (SCOT) and processing them through picking, packing, and shipping. Our vision is to improve customer experience — Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), Speed, Quality, and Cost — while improving associate safety and simplifying our operations. We do so by building products that are highly reliable, resilient, self-healing, scalable, extensible, and designed from the start with a focus on the safety and accessibility of our workforce.

As a Product Manager (Technical) — L6 for Routing and Mansort, you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap that optimizes how units and packages are routed through the fulfillment center and how manual sortation (Mansort) operations are streamlined for throughput, quality, and cost. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group, and develop and maintain product roadmaps and features grounded in team strategy. This role is inherently cross-functional — you will work closely with engineering, science, operations, and business teams across geographies to launch features and build the tools and mechanisms that scale Routing and Mansort worldwide.

responsibilities: Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and requirements.

Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.

ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform — is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.

Job Description

This role owns a key pillar of ERA — the Manufacturing Data Fabric & Intelligence layer. This is the foundational intelligence core: the semantic layer that encodes what manufacturing data means, the metric registry that governs how business outcomes are measured, and the AI Insights and conversational analytics capabilities that surface intelligence to
responsibilities: Platform Strategy & Roadmap

Define the manufacturing semantic layer: encoding metric definitions, operational constraints, supplier relationships, and business rules into a governed ontology that AI agents can reason from

Translate QAD's ERA vision into concrete, sequenced product bets for the intelligence core — partnering with Directors leading the Integration, Governance, and API pillars to ensure the full platform coheres
Lead the evolution of AI Insights capabilities: contextual anomaly detection, plain-language narrative generation, and agentic root cause analysis
AI & Conversational Analytics

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

QAD's AI Platform is the domain intelligence layer that sits between the ERP and autonomous AI agents. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable — transforming QAD from a system of record into a system of action.

Job Description

This role owns the full product lifecycle for QAD's Copilot, Search, and Conversational Analytics capabilities — from architecture through to market launch. You will define what gets built, why it matters to manufacturing users, and how it reaches them: shaping the product vision, driving engineering delivery, and partnering with GTM to ensure adoption.

The intelligence that powers these surfaces — how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how data is retrieved, and how responses are generated — is where QAD's AI moat is built. You will need to engage deeply with these layers, not as an engineer but as the product owner who defines the contracts, quality standards, and sequencing decisions that determine whether they work in production at enterprise scale.

You will report
responsibilities: Copilot & Conversational Analytics
Own the product definition for QAD's Copilot: how queries are understood, context assembled, data retrieved, and responses generated — specifying the contracts that engineering builds against

Define the grounding contract: the rules that ensure every Copilot response cites governed manufacturing data, not hallucinated inference — including confidence signalling and graceful fallback behaviour
Drive the conversational analytics strategy: how natural language queries translate into analytical results across manufacturing data domains without exposing SQL or BI complexity to the user
Specify the disambiguation model: how the Copilot handles ambiguous queries, missing context, and conflicting data signals in real manufacturing workflows
Search
Own the product definition for QAD's semantic search layer: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking, and result structure across manufacturing data domains

Define the search intent taxonomy — operational (find order, trace shipment), analytical (show trends, compare periods), and diagnostic (why is this delayed, what caused this variance) — and specify result formats by intent type
Drive the federated search architecture: how results from ERP operational data, analytical stores, and the knowledge graph are ranked and merged into a coherent, useful response
Discovery, Delivery & GTM
Maintain a structured customer discovery programme — extracting real manufacturing query patterns and translating findings into specific product and architecture implications
Own the product backlog: writing stories to Staff Engineer level of specificity — API contracts, state machines, data flows, edge cases — that engineering can build without verbal clarification
requirements: Product Experience
7–12 years in product management, with significant time owning AI-powered, search, or analytics products in enterprise B2B environments — from definition through production launch
Proven track record owning the full product lifecycle: customer discovery, specification, engineering delivery, and GTM — not just one slice
Experience working in matrixed organisations — driving outcomes across Platform, Engineering, Architecture, and GTM without direct authority
Evidence of structured discovery practice applied to a technical product surface — ability to extract product implications from user research, not just UX insights
Core Technical Depth — Required
These are the primary technical domains this role owns. Strong command is expected from day one.
Semantic search architecture: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking models, and relevance evaluation at enterprise scale
Conversational AI product design: how natural language queries are translated into structured analytical results across complex, domain-specific data without exposing backend complexity to users

LLM-integrated product specification: grounding strategies, hallucination mitigation, response quality gates, and context window management — sufficient to define product contracts engineering builds against

Data platform fluency: OLAP vs operational DB reads, federated search across heterogeneous stores, and how data freshness constraints affect product quality — sufficient to hold authoritative conversations with data engineers
SQL and data modelling: sufficient to validate query plans, understand schema implications, and reason through retrieval architecture trade-offs

Company Description

ERP Logic is a globally recognized SAP Cloud Solutions company, specializing in SAP implementation and application services. Since its inception in 2009, the company has grown significantly to over 1,000 employees and expanded its presence across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, India, and Israel. As one of the top three SAP reseller partners globally for SAP S/4HANA Grow and SAP S/4HANA Rise, ERP Logic serves over 500 customers, including both large enterprises and mid-sized companies. With deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC, ERP Logic supports businesses in transitioning to advanced ERP systems with a customer-centric approach and sustainable solutions.

Role Description

The DADAI (Data, Analytics, Digital & AI Delivery) Domain Product Owner is accountable for translating approved product priorities into delivery-ready scope and for maximizing execution quality across products. The Product Owner owns the product backlog, clarifies requirements, defines acceptance criteria, and ensures delivery teams can execute with clear priorities, technical alignment, and quality standards.

The Product Owner acts as the primary delivery-facing interface between the domain Business Unit priorities (via the IT SHM / Product Manager) and the DADAI delivery factory / CoEs at the product level, ensuring continuous alignment between business intent, delivery execution, and backlog refinement.

Key
responsibilities: The Product Owner contributes execution input required for delivery planning, including:
Translating approved business priorities into clear product scope, epics, features, and user stories.
Identifying execution implications and collaborating with CoEs, Architecture, Data, and delivery teams to refine delivery-ready scope
Assessing execution dependencies, technical constraints, regulatory considerations, and data readiness implications at product level
Defining clear feature scope, acceptance criteria, assumptions, and delivery readiness inputs for planning
Ensuring backlog items are complete, clear, and meet DADAI quality standards prior to PI / sprint planning and delivery execution
Acting as the primary delivery-facing product authority for feature scope, backlog priorities, and acceptance decisions for ARTs, PODs, and vendor teams
Supporting operational feedback loops by translating production learnings, defects, and enhancement requests into backlog refinement and prioritized delivery actions
Success Measures:
Delivery Readiness & Planning Quality
Percentage of features entering PI / sprint planning with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and required architectural or data inputs identified.
Minimizing late discovery of dependencies, data readiness gaps, or scope ambiguity during planning and execution.

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy.
